templates.description: 霓虹灯雨夜城市街道，赛博朋克氛围
templates.description_en: Neon-lit city street on a rainy night, cyberpunk atmosphere
templates.generation_mode: Text to Video (文生视频)【图3可选场景】
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-4s] Cinematic, photorealistic. A wide establishing shot of a rain-soaked cyberpunk city street at night. Towering buildings covered in holographic advertisements and neon signs in Japanese and Chinese characters. Heavy rain falls, creating reflections on the wet asphalt. Steam rises from street grates. A person walks away from camera down the center of the street. The camera slowly tracks forward at eye level. Neon colors — cyan, magenta, and electric blue — reflect off every wet surface. Shallow depth of field. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-7s] Cut to a low-angle medium shot. The person passes under a massive holographic advertisement that flickers and glitches. Rain drops are visible individually in the neon backlight. The camera tilts up slightly to reveal more of the towering cityscape. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000 [7-10s] A flying drone with red indicator lights passes overhead, its searchlight sweeping the street. The person turns a corner into a narrower alley, blue neon light spilling from a doorway. The camera holds on the empty rain-soaked street as the figure disappears.

overall_soundscape: Heavy rain on pavement and metal surfaces, distant thunder, low hum of neon transformers, flying drone buzz, splashing footsteps, and ambient city electronics.

non_diegetic_music: A dark synthwave track with heavy bass, industrial percussion, and atmospheric synth pads, evoking a dystopian noir atmosphere. Slow tempo with building tension.

templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-4s] Cinematic, photorealistic, epic scale. A vast ancient battlefield at dawn. Thousands of armored soldiers stand in formation across a misty plain. Banners flutter in the cold morning wind. The camera is positioned low behind the front rank, looking forward across the field. Dawn light breaks through clouds on the horizon. The camera slowly cranes up to reveal the massive scale of both armies. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-8s] A war horn sounds. The front line begins to march forward, then breaks into a run. The camera tracks alongside the charging soldiers at ground level. Dust kicks up from thousands of feet. Armor and weapons clatter. Individual soldiers' faces show determination and fear. The camera shakes slightly with the impact of the charge. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000 [8-12s] The two armies collide. The camera rises to a high vantage point showing the chaos of battle. Individual combatants clash with swords and shields. Smoke and dust fill the air. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the full scale of the engagement. Dramatic backlight from the rising sun silhouettes the fighters.

overall_soundscape: War horns, thunderous marching, armor clashing, battle cries, horses neighing, swords striking shields, and the roar of thousands of voices.

non_diegetic_music: An epic orchestral track with massive taiko drums, brass section, and choir, building from tension to full crescendo during the charge.

templates.name: 黑色悬疑审讯室

templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-4s] Film noir, high-contrast black-and-white. A stark interrogation room with a single overhead lamp casting a harsh pool of light on a metal table. A person sits in the chair, face half in shadow. The camera is positioned at a low angle from across the table. The only light source is the hanging lamp. Cigarette smoke drifts through the light beam. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-7s] Close-up on the person's face. They lean forward into the light. Their eyes are weary but sharp. A bead of sweat traces down the temple. The camera slowly pushes in. They speak quietly, a short defensive line (the exact words can be set by the user): (S1) says: [Chinese] 我已经说了三遍了。那天晚上我不在场。 [Shot 3] At 00:07.000 [7-10s] Cut to an over-the-shoulder shot from the person's perspective, looking at an empty chair across the table — the interrogator is unseen, only a voice. The unseen interrogator (S2) says in an off-screen voiceover, a short pressure line (the exact words can be set by the user): [Chinese] 再想想。你还有最后一次机会。 The lamp swings slightly from the impact, making shadows shift dramatically.

【STAGE 3 — ATMOSPHERE & QUALITY】Simulated IMAX film camera + Panavision C-series lens (35mm focal, f/4 aperture). Low-saturation teal-and-orange color grade, heavy film grain (35mm stock), volumetric fog catching the overhead light. Subsurface scattering on skin, rough specular on wet surfaces. Chiaroscuro lighting: single harsh key light from above, deep shadows swallowing the background, rim light separating both figures from the darkness.

【STAGE 4 — CAMERA RULES】Handheld shot — extremely subtle, breath-like camera float throughout, as if held by a human operator with slightly unsteady hands. Slow dolly-in toward <Subject 1> as the scene progresses, shallow depth of field (f/4) keeping <Subject 1> sharp while <Subject 2> and the background soften into bokeh. No rapid cuts, no shaky-cam excess — the movement is organic and restrained.

【STAGE 5 — STORYBOARD】

Water drips from the ceiling somewhere off-screen, each drop sending a ripple across the floor. <Subject 2>'s silhouette emerges from the dark corridor in the background, footsteps slow and deliberate.
[2-4s] Tension: <Subject 1>'s eyes flick toward <Subject 2>, jaw tightening. A bead of sweat traces down <Subject 1>'s temple, catching the fluorescent light. <Subject 2> stops ten feet away, shoulders squared. Neither speaks. The fluorescent light above buzzes and flickers once, casting both figures into brief silhouette.
[4-6s] Confrontation: <Subject 2> takes one step forward, boot splashing in a puddle. <Subject 1> shifts weight to the back foot, hands rising slowly into a guarded stance. The camera's breath-like float becomes slightly more pronounced, mirroring the rising tension. A distant metal clang echoes through the empty space.
[6-8s] Empty ending: No dialogue. No explosion. No blinding light. Just the two figures frozen in their stances, rain beginning to fall through a broken skylight, each drop catching the harsh overhead light as it falls. The camera holds on the wide shot, neither figure moving, as the sound of dripping water fades into silence.

overall_soundscape: Production audio only. Heavy, measured breathing from <Subject 1> in the foreground. Slow, deliberate footsteps of <Subject 2> on wet concrete. The constant low hum of a flickering fluorescent tube. Distant water dripping from a broken pipe, each drop echoing in the empty space. A single far-off metal clang somewhere in the building's depths. No music, no score — the silence between sounds is as important as the sounds themselves.

non_diegetic_music: None. No score. Production audio only. The emptiness of the sound design IS the score — every breath, every footstep, every drip carries weight in the silence.

non_diegetic_music: A heavy hip-hop beat with deep bass, crisp snare, and vinyl crackle. Moderate tempo with a head-nodding groove.

templates.name: 芭蕾独舞舞台
templates.description: 芭蕾舞者在剧院舞台上的优雅独舞
templates.description_en: An elegant ballet soloist on a theatre stage
templates.generation_mode: Text to Video (文生视频)【图3可选场景】
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-4s] Cinematic, theatrical. A grand opera house stage with ornate golden proscenium. A ballet dancer stands center stage in fifth position. A single spotlight illuminates her from above. The camera is at orchestra level, medium shot. The stage floor is black and reflective. The dancer begins with a slow, controlled développé — extending one leg forward with perfect poise. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-8s] The dancer transitions into a series of pirouettes — spinning en pointe with arms held in first position. The camera slowly orbits around the dancer. The costume flares with the rotation. Each revolution is precise and controlled. After four turns, the dancer stops in a perfect arabesque — one leg extended behind, arms reaching forward. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000 [8-12s] The dancer begins a grand jeté — leaping across the stage with legs split in mid-air. The camera tracks laterally, following the trajectory. The dancer lands softly and flows into a final reverence — a bow to the audience. The spotlight follows throughout. The empty theater seats are visible in the dark background.

overall_soundscape: Pointe shoes on stage floor — the distinctive tip-tap of toe shoes, fabric rustle, and the acoustic ambience of a large theater.

non_diegetic_music: A classical orchestral piece in the style of Tchaikovsky — sweeping strings, delicate woodwinds, with a building crescendo during the grand jeté.

The dancer jumps energetically with arms in a V-shape above their head, landing on the beat and bouncing back up immediately. The movement is rhythmic, repetitive, and infectious. Other dancers are visible in the background, blurred. The dancer's clothing and hair move dynamically with the jumps. The overall mood is euphoric and high-energy.

overall_soundscape: Pulsing bass, cheering crowd, clothing rustle, footsteps on dance floor, and ambient party sounds.

non_diegetic_music: An upbeat electronic dance track with heavy four-on-the-floor kick, bright synth lead, and build-up effects. 128 BPM with euphoric drops.

templates.name: 山顶日出延时摄影
templates.description: 云海翻涌的山顶日出延时摄影效果
templates.description_en: Time-lapse sunrise from a mountain top above a churning sea of clouds
templates.generation_mode: Text to Video (文生视频)【图3可选场景】
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-10s] Cinematic, photorealistic timelapse. A high mountain summit at dawn. Below, a vast sea of clouds fills the valleys. The camera is fixed at a wide-angle vantage point. The sky transitions from deep indigo to purple to warm orange as the sun rises behind distant peaks. Light rays break through the clouds, creating god rays. The cloud sea undulates and shifts like ocean waves. As the sun clears the horizon, golden light floods the scene, illuminating the mountain's rocky face. The camera slowly pushes in with very small amplitude. Frost on nearby rocks sparkles as it catches the first light. The entire sequence conveys the passage of approximately 30 minutes in 10 seconds of video.

overall_soundscape: High-altitude wind, distant bird calls, and the subtle natural ambience of a mountain dawn.

non_diegetic_music: A serene orchestral track with slow string swells, gentle piano, and soft brass, building to a warm crescendo as the sun clears the horizon.

templates.name: 海岸海浪拍岸

templates.description_en: A calm scene of waves breaking against a rocky coast

templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-8s] Cinematic, photorealistic. A rugged coastline at golden hour. Large ocean waves roll in from the horizon, cresting and crashing against dark rock formations. White foam explodes on impact and rushes up the shore. The camera is positioned at a medium-wide angle, slightly elevated. Sea spray catches the warm backlight, creating a misty glow. The horizon glows orange-pink. Seagulls wheel in the distance. The rhythm of the waves is hypnotic — each wave slightly different in size and shape. Wet rocks glisten with reflected light. The camera holds steady, letting the natural power of the ocean be the focus. Long exposure effect on the water creates smooth, silky textures in the receding surf.

overall_soundscape: Rhythmic ocean waves crashing and retreating, sea spray, distant seagulls, and coastal wind.

non_diegetic_music: A gentle ambient track with soft piano notes and oceanic synth textures, peaceful and meditative.

templates.name: 四季变换延时
templates.description: 同一场景经历春夏秋冬四季变换的延时效果
templates.description_en: Time-lapse of the same scene passing through all four seasons
templates.generation_mode: Text to Video (文生视频)【图3可选场景】
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-12s] Cinematic timelapse. A single tree in a grassy field undergoes all four seasons in rapid succession. [0-3s] Spring: bare branches bud with fresh green leaves, grass turns vibrant green, cherry blossoms bloom around the base, light is soft and fresh. [3-6s] Summer: the tree is in full leaf, deep green canopy, grass is tall and lush, warm golden light, butterflies and dragonflies flit through the frame. [6-9s] Autumn: leaves turn from green to gold, orange, and red, then begin to fall — swirling in the wind, grass browns and dries, light becomes amber and low. [9-12s] Winter: the tree is bare, snow falls and accumulates on branches and ground, the scene is monochrome white and grey, cold blue light. The transitions between seasons are smooth — one morphs into the next with visible changes spreading across the frame. The camera is fixed throughout.

overall_soundscape: Wind sounds that change character with each season — gentle spring breeze, warm summer gust, autumn leaf-rustle wind, and cold winter howl. Bird songs in spring and summer, silence in winter.

non_diegetic_music: A contemplative piano piece that shifts in key and mood with each season — light and hopeful in spring, warm and full in summer, melancholic in autumn, and sparse and crystalline in winter.

templates.name: 太空行走
templates.description: 宇航员在太空中行走的壮丽场景
templates.description_en: A magnificent scene of an astronaut walking in space
templates.generation_mode: Text to Video (文生视频)【图3可选场景】
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-4s] Cinematic, photorealistic. An astronaut in a white EVA suit floats outside a space station with Earth visible below. The curvature of the Earth fills the lower third of the frame — blue oceans, white cloud formations, and the glowing edge of the atmosphere. The camera is positioned at a three-quarter angle, medium shot of the astronaut. The astronaut begins a slow forward motion, using handholds on the station exterior. Sunlight creates extreme contrast — the lit side of the suit is blindingly bright, the shadow side is pure black. Stars fill the vacuum of space. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-7s] The astronaut reaches the end of the handhold rail and pushes off gently, floating free. The camera slowly orbits around the astronaut. Earth rotates slowly in the background. The astronaut's tether cable drifts behind. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000 [7-10s] The astronaut looks toward camera — the reflective gold visor shows a reflection of the camera and Earth behind it. The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the vast scale of the station and the smallness of the human figure against the planet.

overall_soundscape: Complete silence of space — no sound transmission. Only the internal sounds of the suit: breathing, radio static, suit air circulation, and occasional suit joint movements.

non_diegetic_music: A space ambient track with ethereal synth pads, slow strings, and subtle electronic pulses. Vast, contemplative, and otherworldly.

templates.name: 魔法森林奇遇

templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-4s] Fantasy, cinematic. A mystical forest at twilight. Massive ancient trees with glowing runes carved into their bark. Bioluminescent mushrooms dot the forest floor in blues and purples. Floating orbs of light drift between the trees like fireflies but larger and slower. The camera moves forward at a slow walking pace, tracking through the undergrowth. Mist hugs the ground. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-7s] A small creature — part fox, part light — darts across the path ahead, leaving a trail of sparkle. The camera follows the creature's path. The glowing flora pulses in response to the creature's passage. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000 [7-10s] The camera arrives at a small clearing with a pool of water that reflects the canopy of lights above. A large ancient stone archway stands at the far end, covered in moss and glowing symbols. The water's surface ripples on its own. The camera holds on this tableau. Particles of light rise from the pool and drift upward into the canopy.

overall_soundscape: Ethereal chimes, distant crystalline sounds, soft wind through leaves, water dripping and rippling, and unidentifiable magical creature sounds.

non_diegetic_music: A fantasy orchestral track with harp, celesta, and soft choir, creating a dreamlike, otherworldly atmosphere. Slow, magical, and wondrous.

templates.name: 时间穿越隧道
templates.description: 穿越时空隧道的超现实视觉效果
templates.description_en: A surreal visual of travelling through a time tunnel
templates.generation_mode: Text to Video (文生视频)【图3可选场景】
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-8s] Surreal, cinematic. A person stands in a featureless white room. Behind them, a crack appears in the air — reality splits open, revealing a swirling tunnel of light, color, and temporal fragments. The camera is at a medium shot, facing the person. The person turns to look at the portal. Fragments of different time periods are visible in the tunnel walls — Roman columns, medieval castles, modern skyscrapers, future cityscapes — all distorted and flowing. The person steps backward into the portal. As they enter, their appearance shifts rapidly through different eras of clothing — toga, armor, suit, spacesuit — cycling faster and faster. The camera pushes forward into the portal after them. Light streaks past at extreme speed. Colors shift through the spectrum. The tunnel converges to a single bright point of light that fills the frame.

overall_soundscape: A building wind sound, crystalline chimes, distorted echoes of different historical sounds (chariots, swords, trains, rockets), and a rising sonic whoosh that peaks at the moment of entry.

non_diegetic_music: An electronic track with pulsing arpeggios that accelerate throughout, building from ambient to intense, with a massive crescendo at the moment of portal entry.

templates.name: 地铁通勤时光

templates.description_en: A slice of city commuter life inside a subway car
templates.generation_mode: Text to Video (文生视频)【图3可选场景】
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-4s] Cinematic, urban. The interior of a subway car during evening commute. Fluorescent lights cast a slightly green-tinged glow. The car is half-full of passengers — one reading on a phone, one resting with eyes closed, one with headphones, one carrying a shopping bag. The camera is at a medium-wide angle from one end of the car. Through the window behind the passengers, tunnel lights streak past rhythmically. The train sways gently. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-7s] The camera slowly trucks left along the car, passing each passenger. Each person is briefly framed — their face, their posture, their small movements. One passenger scrolls a phone. Another's head nods slightly, almost asleep. Another's head bobs to music. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000 [7-10s] The train slows. The lights flicker briefly. A station platform appears outside the windows. One passenger looks up from a phone and stands, gathering a bag. The doors open with a pneumatic hiss. Cool platform air flows in. The camera holds on the open doorway as a few people exit and new passengers board.

overall_soundscape: Train rumble on tracks, rhythmic tunnel light passing, air conditioning hum, phone notification sounds, doors opening pneumatic hiss, platform announcements, and footsteps boarding.

non_diegetic_music: A lo-fi hip-hop track with mellow piano, soft drums, and vinyl crackle. Nostalgic, contemplative, and urban.
